result.scope: Same host/device, exact Godot-compiled SPIR-V and input bytes. Buffer equality covers depth, winner ownership and material accumulation. GPU intervals are paired before aggregation. Five hot samples are diagnostic, not a sustained game benchmark. Godot samples alternate bank order at a fixed camera; native does the same. Native omits field, shadows, shading and presentation. CPU intervals have explicitly different scopes. Host-visible replay buffers are experimental and are not a production mobile memory design. Software Vulkan timings do not establish Mali performance.

static_arm_compiler.scope: Static compilation of the original Godot-produced SPIR-V for four Arm core/compiler models. Loop trip counts, actual memory contention, driver version, thermal limits and frame times are not measured. Successful compilation is not device compatibility certification.

compatibility_gaps.unchanged_spirv_binary_requirement: Vulkan 1.2, or Vulkan 1.1 with VK_KHR_spirv_1_4 and dependencies enabled; other compile targets and backends require validation

physical_v601_user_report.scope: User-pasted physical Android summary for 6.0.1 only; no raw per-pass GPU intervals were supplied. These numbers are not v6.3 measurements.
